name: Reaper Fleeting Soul reduces Soulslam cooldown natively
contract: Fleeting Soul 712683 promises 'Reduces the cooldown of Soulslam by 15 sec'.
Its DBC effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints
Soulslam rank 1 (504014) has SpellFamilyName 36 and SpellFamilyFlags[0] 67108864, an exact match.
Player::GetSpellRecoveryTime calls ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, recovery) unconditionally for every
spell cast, so this native engine mechanism delivers the tooltip with no CoA-specific handler required.

steps.label: No cooldown reduction without Fleeting Soul
Soulslam rank 1 cooldown reduced by exactly 15 sec
